name: Relocatable Instance Root
purpose: allow the complete site runtime tree to be deployed under a temporary prefix such as /test/ and later promoted to the domain root without changing canonical site data or domain code

logicalVsPhysical.rule: canonical records and contracts store logical root paths; runtime projects them through the active instance root

promotion.test: deploy complete mirrored site tree below /test/
promotion.production: deploy the same mirrored tree at /

rules: the literal word test is deployment data, not application semantics
SiteTree paths remain canonical logical paths such as /lmts/
current browser paths are stripped back to logical paths before SiteTree resolution
navigation links are projected back through the active instance root
instance-root projection must not permit path traversal or cross-origin path injection
existing production surfaces remain untouched until explicit cutover
IAM and LMTS implementation roots live under /app/iam/ and /app/lmts/; /iam/ and /lmts/ are public projections
